chatTemplate.systemPrompt: Klyvaron first-party language model. Answer directly from available context and state clearly when supporting evidence is absent.

limitations: klyvaron-max-lm was trained on 378,880 tokens (95 steps, CPU host without GPU); the published Chinchilla compute-optimal target is 1,841,541,320 tokens, so open-domain world knowledge and long-form fluency remain far narrower than a frontier GPU-trained assistant.
Grounding verdict and expressed-state heads are trained on structured repository passages and must be treated as runtime signals rather than infallible truth.
All training data came from 15 permissive open-source software/documentation repositories (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, PSF-2.0); non-software domains are out of distribution.
This host has no GPU, so GPU accelerated runtime execution and target-device hardware qualification remain open.
A relative quantization check is not assistant capability, native-device qualification or a release approval.
